minutes.headline: Trust Fund Commission voted to advertise its funds, file its vacancy bylaw text, and move meetings to Wednesdays.
minutes.summary: The chair and one other commissioner voted to put a small trust-fund notice in the special town meeting booklet, approved a summary and filing of the vacancy bylaw text for the November special town meeting, and moved meetings to the 2nd and 4th Wednesday. Most of the time went to a presentation on write-in election results for the vacant seat and a long update on the school department's refusal to give trust and scholarship fund records. September 24 minutes were accepted.

budget_items.what_was_said: The chair said the trust funds in the investment pool appear to be doing well, and described past retirement-fund-style gains over several years.
The chair said the treasurer likely has authority to pay for a small ad annually from the funds without a yearly appropriation, if it doesn't touch principal unless the fund allows management draws.

budget_items.what_was_said: The district's list shows scholarship entries marked town-managed under a town account; the chair said these belong with the town treasurer.
The school committee voted two payments from the Beth Curtis fund, which the select board signed without a fund instrument.
The town is not assessing a fee for the records request; the district reserved the right to assess fees.

decisions.decision: Chair will send the approved fund notice to the town manager and aims to repeat it at each town meeting plus a possible public-access channel plug.
Next meeting moves to Wednesday, October 21, at 5 p.m., with meetings thereafter on the 2nd and 4th Wednesday.
Risk management policy rewrite and website posting updates deferred; school-fund matters to be detailed at a later meeting.

what_happened.line: The commission voted unanimously to file sections 1 through 11 of its continuity bylaw with the town clerk and send the text to the town manager and select board.
It also approved the brief summary for submission to the town manager, and updated its section-by-section explanation to the September 10th wording.
A unanimous vote added a small advertisement describing available trust funds to the special town meeting booklet.
Meetings move from the 2nd and 4th Thursday to the 2nd and 4th Wednesday at 5 p.m., starting October 21.
The commission heard an update on the school department's response to its request for trust and scholarship fund records; no vote was taken.

why_it_matters: The bylaw text now on file is what voters are likely to see in the warrant for the November special town meeting, so it is the document to read before that vote.
Which office holds the school-managed scholarship funds is still open in the minutes, and residents who rely on those funds have no stated resolution yet.
